A1.justification: Both PDFs describe DeepVideo-R1 and contain the complete main paper, Tables 1-8, Figures 1-4, and Appendices A-F. Text extraction and visual inspection support comparison without material gaps.

before.justification: v3 reports original DeepVideo-R1 benchmark evaluations, training-method comparisons, ablations, training curves, and a qualitative example in Tables 1-8 and Figures 3-4.

after.justification: v5 retains these original benchmark evaluations, comparisons, ablations, training curves, and qualitative results.

M1.justification: The Reg-GRPO objective, normalized advantage prediction, difficulty measurement, reasoning-hint augmentation, and Gaussian-noise augmentation are unchanged. The appendix derivation correction does not change the final loss or training procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions retain SEED-Bench-R1, LongVideoBench, VSI-Bench, Video-MMMU, MMVU, MVBench, TempCompass, Video-MME, and NExTGQA coverage. Video-R1 training data and the in-distribution, cross-environment, and cross-task scenarios are unchanged; dataset-name edits clarify existing references.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain the same video-model and vision-expert baselines, SFT, GRPO, DPO, Online DPO, REINFORCE, RLOO, REBEL, and reward regression. Appendix D polishes their descriptions without changing comparator membership or procedures.

E3.justification: The model configurations, splits, frame processing, reward functions, and evaluation metrics in Section 4 and Appendices B, C, and E are retained. Appendix C.2 clarifies timestamp notation and the top-1 interpretation of R@m without changing the formulas or evaluation protocol.

E4.justification: Tables 4 and 6-8 retain the same component, difficulty-reference, augmentation-direction, and augmentation-scaling ablations. Figures 3-4 retain the vanishing-advantage analysis, reward curves, and qualitative example; no new robustness tests or supplementary analyses appear.

E5.justification: Both versions explicitly state in checklist item 7 that experiments used a single run. There are no changes to seed information, repeated-run counts, uncertainty-reporting practices, or significance procedures.

E6.justification: Section 4.2 corrects the TempCompass score in prose from 631 to 63.1, matching the unchanged Table 2. Section 4.3 corrects the Reg-GRPO ablation gain from 4.17 to 4.1 points, matching Table 4's 39.5 minus 35.4. The tabulated results and plotted findings are otherwise unchanged.

T1.justification: Appendix A.3, Eq. (17), replaces additive Z(x) terms with log Z(x), correcting the intermediate substitution from the reward expression in Eq. (15). The cancellation, final normalized advantage, and Reg-GRPO objective remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: advantage regression without GRPO's clipping/min safeguards, difficulty-aware augmentation addressing vanishing advantages, and improved video reasoning. Rewording does not alter these claims' scientific scope.

C2.justification: Appendix F.1 slightly narrows its reassurance from DeepVideo-R1 having no negative impacts to introducing no new negative impacts. Existing discussions of inherited bias, emissions, possible pretraining-data leakage, and computational limitations remain, as do the interpretations of experimental results.

D1.justification: Appendix C.1 retains the same software libraries, frozen visual encoder, A100/H200 hardware, group size of 8, history window of 100 samples, KL coefficient of 0.1, and frame-processing details. Code-access information is unchanged; the revisions polish wording and library names.

R1.justification: The cited works and reference list are unchanged. Section 2 and Appendix A.4 preserve the same positioning relative to GRPO, DPO, REBEL, and video reasoning work despite language edits.

P1.justification: Copyediting across the main text and appendices corrects grammar, typos, and terminology, including 'less studyed,' the stray 'textbf,' and 'difficulty increasement/decreasement.' These are phrase- and sentence-level refinements; the section hierarchy and narrative organization remain intact.

P2.justification: Figure 2 and Table 7 captions adopt corrected augmentation terminology, with small spacing and text-reflow adjustments elsewhere. All figures and tables retain their content and structure, and no display is added or removed.

improvement.justification: v5 improves accuracy and readability by aligning two numerical statements with Tables 2 and 4, correcting the log Z(x) substitution in Appendix A.3, and cleaning up awkward prose. These resolve localized inconsistencies while leaving the methodology and experimental evidence unchanged, supporting a limited overall quality improvement.
